intro: The Philippines has over 110 million people, and around 10 million more Filipinos live and work abroad.

chapters.title: Languages
text: Filipino (based on Tagalog) and English are official, and over 170 languages are spoken, including Cebuano and Ilocano. Many people switch between Filipino and English in 'Taglish'.

chapters.title: Faith and family
text: About 80% of people are Catholic, making the Philippines one of the largest Catholic countries. Muslims live mainly in Mindanao. Family ties are strong, and celebrations are big.
Filipino nurses, sailors and domestic workers work all over the world.
